failure_modes.name: Grain crack at the hinge
failure_modes.text: loop 1 (end opposite the spine): tension-face strain 18.9 % loose to 20.6 % taut (closed-form limit 50.0 %), inside radius 0.50 mm, R/t = 0.5; the model's leather bridges this stack, so the closed form is the number to read; inside radius below 1 x t: the grain relies on the finish to hold, expect cracking (R/t=0.50); outer-fibre strain >= 20 % (screening threshold, not a validated failure criterion). Cycles to crack need flex-test data.

failure_modes.name: Permanent set
failure_modes.text: needs a cyclic viscoplastic model and fold-and-measure data; it is the usual first visible sign of a worn hinge

failure_modes.name: Finish crazing or delamination
failure_modes.text: a film-on-substrate model quoted in prior-research/reference/durability.md section 2b has a stiff finish buckling at 2-12 % compressive strain; at loop 1 (end opposite the spine) the compression face is -17.7 % and the grain is in tension, not compression

failure_modes.name: Stress at stitch holes
failure_modes.text: stitching (thread ties) crosses or pins the fold(s): loop 1 (end opposite the spine), loop 2 (end opposite the spine). Holes in a bend remove part of the section there. No local model yet

failure_modes.name: Skive-line or thickness step
failure_modes.text: whether the folds are skived is not recorded; a skive line is a stiffness step where cracks start

failure_modes.name: Edge paint chipping
failure_modes.text: the edge treatment is not recorded; record it (painted edges chip where they flex)

failure_modes.name: Pocket-mouth and corner abrasion
failure_modes.text: no pockets recorded (the photographs show some; they are not described yet); needs the card-pull scenario (roadmap phase 4) and wear photos to calibrate

failure_modes.name: Perforation tear line
failure_modes.text: holes through the fold(s) (their number is not recorded)

failure_modes.name: Layer delamination
failure_modes.text: layers are treated as perfectly bonded; the record does not say what is glued

failure_modes.name: Cold embrittlement
failure_modes.text: needs a cold flex test; no built-in factor

failure_modes.name: Over-drying
failure_modes.text: needs a measured material state (stiffness and strain to crack at a stated humidity)

failure_modes.name: Long-term chemical ageing
failure_modes.text: ageing enters only through measured aged states; none recorded
